name: SCR reagent systems (ammonia/urea storage, dosing, injection grids; ammonium sulfate/bisulfate in HRSGs)
description: Store and deliver aqueous ammonia (or anhydrous ammonia / urea) to an ammonia injection grid (AIG) upstream of the SCR catalyst; tuning of AIG distribution controls NOx removal, ammonia slip and downstream ammonium bisulfate (ABS) / ammonium sulfate (AS) deposition on air-preheater or HRSG tube surfaces. Flow-correction devices (turning vanes, static mixers, graduated straightening grids) and CFD are used to obtain uniform NH3/NOx distribution. Primary source: https://www.ccj-online.com/aig-upgrades-slash-ammonia-consumption-tube-fouling
